brands.name: Eye of the Sun Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped surfboards by Tommy George in Long Branch, New Jersey — twin fins, fishes, and logs built one at a time for East Coast beach breaks.

models.name: Remedy
models.description: A pulled-in twin-fin fish with curves in all the right places. Built to handle anything from waist-high to overhead, it’s fast down the line and equally at home drawing long, flowing lines or hitting top-to-bottom maneuvers. The Remedy is the perfect fix for shortboard frustration—responsive, playful, and made to keep you moving in every kind of wave.

models.name: Nug
models.description: Round nose twin fin for maximizing smaller days. Provides a super fast and loos approach to small waves.

models.name: Positive Reality
models.description: A winged swallow-tail twin fin built for small days but ready to push into overhead, rippable surf. The pulled-in nose and tail give it drive down the line while still letting you surf top to bottom with confidence. A true performance twin, it also takes a trailer fin for extra control when the surf demands it.

models.name: Caravan
models.description: Nose rider with a wider nose than the Crystal Ship. This allows for a super stable log that will maximize the super small days and provide ease of walking in all conditions.
